summary: Frontend-only test of the shared name-it-then-what-next popup (JamSavedPopup) in Beat Lab, Song Studio, and Jam Session (regression), plus the Main Stage saved-jam playback fix. Every flow listed in the request passed. Beat Lab: REC -> STOP -> beat-save-popup (placeholder 'Beat N'). Naming it saved the rename to jma_saved_beats_v1 and showed beat-saved-title. Jam went to /free-play?beat=<id> (showed 'Jamming to: <name>'), Cover went to /academy?panel=album&cover=<id> (cover-designer opened), New cleared the grid and closed the popup, Keep closed it and loop-jam-on-it stayed visible. Song Studio: Surprise Me -> Save -> name input prefilled (e.g. 'Cosmic Song'). Cancel closed the popup and saved nothing. Save showed song-saved-title. Jam went to /free-play?song=<id>, Cover went to /academy?panel=album&cover=<id>, New emptied all 16 slots, Keep closed the popup. The song appeared in the Songs gallery. Jam Session: Record bells -> Stop -> Save to Album -> jam-save-popup -> name -> cover/stage/album/keep all work. Audio check: decoding the saved IndexedDB blob (audio/mp3) gave non-silent audio for both Bells (RMS 0.044, peak 0.22) and Piano (RMS 0.057, peak 0.22), so piano is now captured in recordings. Main Stage: /rank-hall?jam=<id> and setlist pick both play through Web Audio. Progress went 3% -> 24% -> 46% -> 67% -> 98%, then the performance ended and STANDING OVATION showed. Pressing STOP mid-song ends it cleanly with no restart. No page errors. Layout: all popups (beat, song, jam; name and choices steps) fit inside 844x390 and 667x375 with no buttons off screen, and inside 1920x800.

ui_bugs.issue: If the grid is empty (or all lanes muted), stopRecording returns early (tracks.length === 0) without any feedback: no popup, no toast. A child may think saving is broken.

issues: The global fullscreen button (bottom-right) shows above the popup backdrop and slightly overlaps the card's bottom-right corner. Cosmetic only, nothing is blocked.
The rank-up overlay (z-[1000]) can open on top of the save popup (z-[160]) when the save earns the first badge. It has to be dismissed first, but it works.

action_items: Optional: show a hint such as 'Add some beats first!' when REC/STOP happens on an empty Beat Lab grid

Optional: in RankHallPage perform() jam branch, the silent 'return' when decode or fetch fails leaves no feedback. Show a message, and guard against the component unmounting during the async fetch/decode (audio could start after the user leaves the page).
critical_code_review_comments: RankHallPage.perform (jam): after the awaits (getJamAudioUrl, fetch, decodeAudioData) there is no mounted/cancelled check. If the user leaves the page during decoding, src.start() still runs after the unmount cleanup, so audio would play off-page with no way to stop it.
RankHallPage.perform (jam): a decode failure returns silently after the picker is already closed. The UI looks like nothing happened.
JamSavedPopup has no backdrop-click or Escape dismiss, and Beat Lab passes no onCancel. That is acceptable because the beat is already saved before naming, but users must press Save to close it.
Files over 700 lines: FreePlayPage.js (1045), SongStudioPage.js (796), LoopStudioPage.js (750). Consider splitting.
seed_data_creation: Only TEST_-prefixed beats, songs and jams in the localStorage/IndexedDB of throwaway headless browser contexts. No server data was touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The app uses a hash router: use BASE + '/#/route'. Init script: localStorage jma_unlock_all_v1, jma_reveal_seen_v1, jma_player_name_skipped_v1 = '1' and sessionStorage jma_portrait_ok_v1 = '1'. Dismiss tour-start-modal-close, rank-up-dismiss and the text "I'll add my name later" (they can appear late, so dismiss again before key clicks). Beat Lab needs a preset (preset-Basic-Beat or preset-Hip-Hop) before REC, otherwise no popup. Jam Session: sound-mode-bells, then capture-jam-btn, then keys 1-8, then capture-stop-btn, then capture-save-album-btn. Saved jams are in localStorage jma_saved_jams_v1, with audio in IndexedDB jma_media_v1/jams (key = jam id), and can be decoded with OfflineAudioContext to check RMS. Main Stage progress bar: [data-testid=rank-hall-now-performing] span.block style.width. Ovation: rank-hall-ovation (visible for 3.2s). Setlist item: stage-setlist-<id>. Note: page.goto to the same hash route does not remount, so open modals stay open. Go to /home first.
